verdicts.reason: A and B are practically the same, and both are broken in the same ways. The search-bar pill is now empty and sits on its own at the top, with its search button gone and the headline moved below it, so the design's central 'typing in a search bar' idea is lost. The red CTA has shrunk to an unreadable strip that is smaller than the subtitle, so the hierarchy is inverted. The photo of laptops and other desk items is reduced to a cropped corner of the glasses, and a stray fragment of black arc floats in the bottom corner. The only difference is a tiny shift in that arc, which is not enough to separate them.
